title: GPS-BLOCK-BANK2: dyadic typed descriptors and persistent bit-field fetch

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE GPS-BLOCK-BANK2 physical implementation in proof.md executes the complete GPS-BLOCK logical program of gps-source.md with identical output channel, private-sign/extraction erasure, low-residue routing, four literal hard cutoffs, original acquisition schedule and full finite n<256 branch. Under the exact canonical independent-ideal-copy promise it recovers the ENTIRE s with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. Every generated bit/gate/measurement, field fetch, full address, source move, initialization, padding/inactive cell, failed attempt and complete output-first cleanup is counted on EVERY branch. The direct interpreter stages only bounded address fields and maps already-classical data to measured basis cells, never a coherent quantum query address. No QRAM, free word arithmetic, source inverse/control, purification, instruction oracle or arbitrary phase primitive is used. ALL FIVE guarantees hold JOINTLY for this SAME actual implementation. Charged sequential time is O(n^(5/2)(log2n)^(5/2) 2^((176777/250000)sqrt(n log2n))), exact growth index1/2. The dyadic reference-controller CORE ledger, re-established term by term from the complete source templates and literal caps before physical addressing, is O(n^(5/2)(log2n)^(1/2)2^R); each expanded primitive incurs at most O((log n)^2) full physical work including descriptor fetch, gate generation and addressing. The unchanged source proves the exact rational R-envelope; public layout/init/release polynomial work is separately paid and absorbed. This is a worst-case-branch bound, not an expected runtime. This NEW implementation uses dyadic padded descriptor/record strides, typed finite field locators, persistent read/staging pointers and borrow termination. Its reference CORE ledger is re-established term by term; no automatic compiler or old flat-pointer translation is assumed.
